text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, November 12, 2018 Posted by admin on November 12th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Coca Cola (KO), Disney (DIS), McDonald’s (MCD), Merck (MRK), UnitedHealth (UNH) and Verizon (VZ). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -61 points.
Friday the Dow was down -201.92 (-0.77%) at 25,989.30.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.14%.
There were 11 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Disney (DIS) +1.72%, Procter & Gamble (PG) +1.15% and Pfizer (PFE) +0.98%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Goldman Sachs (GS) -3.89%, Cisco (CSCO) -2.75% and Microsoft (MSFT) -1.95%.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down eight-tenths of a cent at $2.695 per gallon.
